effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[Main] If you have a level 5 or higher green Digimon in play, by suspending this Tamer, hatch 1 Digi-Egg card to an empty space in your breeding area, or move 1 level 3 or higher Digimon from your breeding area to your battle area.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
